### Total-adult based

Stock is defined as all adults (>200 g) present at the October 1 census in year Y−lag, with no harvest correction. Recruits are the total adults in the October 1 census of year Y plus fish harvested in summer of year Y (those removed before the census who would otherwise have been counted). Unlike the spawner-based approach, this definition includes adults that did not spawn due to poor condition, capturing condition-driven variation in spawning propensity across habitat scenarios and cold proportions.

#### Derive stock-recruitment curves

Derive adult-to-adult stock-recruitment curves over 4 different lag periods (2–5 years), for abundance and biomass separately.
```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 18

# ── Total adult abundance and biomass per scenario per year ───────────────────
# Stock  (X): Oct 1 census adults > 200 g only — no harvest correction
# Recruits (Y): Oct 1 census adults + same-year harvest (removed before census)
get_total_adults <- function(scen) {
  base_cols <- list(
    hab_type          = scen$ht,
    prop_cold         = scen$pc,
    prop_cold_fact    = factor(
      pc_labels_mech[match(scen$pc, pc_levels_mech)],
      levels = pc_labels_mech
    ),
    harvest_rate      = scen$hr,
    harvest_rate_fact = factor(scen$hr,
                               levels = hr_levels_mech,
                               labels = hr_labels_mech)
  )
  oct_adults <- scen$oct1_adult

  if (is.null(scen$harvest)) {
    oct_adults |>
      right_join(sr_exp_years, by = "yr") |>
      replace_na(list(n_oct1 = 0L, biom_oct1 = 0)) |>
      mutate(n_harv = 0L, biom_harv = 0,
             n_total_adults    = n_oct1,
             biom_total_adults = biom_oct1,
             !!!base_cols,
             hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")))
  } else {
    harv_yr <- scen$harvest |>
      group_by(yr = year) |>
      summarise(n_harv    = n(),
                biom_harv = sum(weight) / 1000,
                .groups   = "drop")
    oct_adults |>
      right_join(sr_exp_years, by = "yr") |>
      left_join(harv_yr, by = "yr") |>
      replace_na(list(n_oct1 = 0L, biom_oct1 = 0, n_harv = 0L, biom_harv = 0)) |>
      mutate(n_total_adults    = n_oct1    + n_harv,
             biom_total_adults = biom_oct1 + biom_harv,
             !!!base_cols) |>
      mutate(hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")))
  }
}

total_adults_ts <- purrr::map_dfr(ibm_list_mech, get_total_adults)

# ── Build lagged SR dataset + Ricker fits ────────────────────────────────────
build_adult_sr_v2 <- function(lag) {
  ts <- total_adults_ts |>
    select(hab_type, prop_cold, prop_cold_fact, harvest_rate, harvest_rate_fact,
           yr, n_recruited = n_total_adults, biom_recruited = biom_total_adults) |>
    mutate(yr_parent = yr - lag) |>
    left_join(
      total_adults_ts |>
        transmute(hab_type, prop_cold, yr, harvest_rate,
                  n_stock    = n_oct1,
                  biom_stock = biom_oct1),
      by = c("hab_type", "prop_cold", "yr_parent" = "yr", "harvest_rate")
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(n_stock), n_stock > 0, n_recruited > 0) |>
    mutate(hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")))

  summ <- ts |>
    group_by(hab_type, prop_cold, prop_cold_fact, harvest_rate, harvest_rate_fact) |>
    summarise(
      across(c(n_recruited, n_stock, biom_recruited, biom_stock),
             list(mean = mean, sd = sd)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Fit Ricker separately per hab_type × prop_cold group
  hab_fits <- ts |>
    group_by(hab_type, prop_cold, prop_cold_fact) |>
    group_split() |>
    purrr::map(\(d) {
      fit_n <- tryCatch(
        nls(n_recruited ~ a * n_stock * exp(-b * n_stock),
            data = d, start = list(a = 5, b = 0.05)),
        error = \(e) NULL)
      fit_b <- tryCatch(
        nls(biom_recruited ~ a * biom_stock * exp(-b * biom_stock),
            data = d, start = list(a = 5, b = 0.05)),
        error = \(e) NULL)
      N_seq <- seq(0, max(d$n_stock),    length.out = 300)
      B_seq <- seq(0, max(d$biom_stock), length.out = 300)
      mk_pred <- function(fit, xvar, seq_) {
        if (is.null(fit)) return(
          tibble(x = numeric(), y = numeric(),
                 hab_type = character(), prop_cold_fact = character()))
        tibble(x = seq_,
               y = predict(fit, setNames(list(seq_), xvar)),
               hab_type       = d$hab_type[1],
               prop_cold_fact = d$prop_cold_fact[1])
      }
      list(
        hab_type       = as.character(d$hab_type[1]),
        prop_cold_fact = as.character(d$prop_cold_fact[1]),
        alpha_n  = if (!is.null(fit_n)) log(coef(fit_n)["a"]) else NA,
        alpha_b  = if (!is.null(fit_b)) log(coef(fit_b)["a"]) else NA,
        beta_n   = if (!is.null(fit_n)) coef(fit_n)["b"]      else NA,
        beta_b   = if (!is.null(fit_b)) coef(fit_b)["b"]      else NA,
        s_star_n = if (!is.null(fit_n)) log(coef(fit_n)["a"]) / coef(fit_n)["b"] else NA,
        s_star_b = if (!is.null(fit_b)) log(coef(fit_b)["a"]) / coef(fit_b)["b"] else NA,
        pred_n   = mk_pred(fit_n, "n_stock",    N_seq),
        pred_b   = mk_pred(fit_b, "biom_stock", B_seq)
      )
    })

  # Combine predictions, preserving hab_type and prop_cold_fact for faceting
  pred_n <- purrr::map_dfr(hab_fits, "pred_n") |>
    mutate(hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")))
  pred_b <- purrr::map_dfr(hab_fits, "pred_b") |>
    mutate(hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")))

  list(lag = lag, ts = ts, summ = summ, hab_fits = hab_fits,
       pred_n = pred_n, pred_b = pred_b)
}

sr_v2 <- purrr::map(2:5, build_adult_sr_v2)

# Print equilibrium S* for each lag × hab_type × prop_cold
purrr::walk(sr_v2, \(x)
  purrr::walk(x$hab_fits, \(hf)
    cat(sprintf("Lag %d yr [%s, %s] — S* abundance: %.1f | S* biomass: %.2f kg\n",
                x$lag, hf$hab_type, hf$prop_cold_fact,
                hf$s_star_n %||% NA, hf$s_star_b %||% NA))
  )
)

# ── Helper: one adult SR panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────
adult_sr_panel_v2 <- function(dat, summ, x_raw, y_raw, x_summ, y_summ,
                               x_sd, y_sd, pred_df, x_lab, y_lab, title) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = {{ x_raw }}, y = {{ y_raw }}, color = harvest_rate_fact)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1.5, shape = 16) +
    geom_point(data = summ, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = {{ x_summ }}, y = {{ y_summ }},
                   color = harvest_rate_fact),
               size = 3.5, shape = 16) +
    geom_errorbar(data = summ, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  aes(x    = {{ x_summ }},
                      ymin = pmax(0, {{ y_summ }} - {{ y_sd }}),
                      ymax = {{ y_summ }} + {{ y_sd }},
                      color = harvest_rate_fact),
                  width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = summ, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x    = pmax(0, {{ x_summ }} - {{ x_sd }}),
                     xend = {{ x_summ }} + {{ x_sd }},
                     y    = {{ y_summ }}, yend = {{ y_summ }},
                     color = harvest_rate_fact),
                 linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(data = pred_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = x, y = y),
              linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = hr_pal, name = "Harvest rate") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    expand_limits(x = 0, y = 0) +
    facet_wrap(~ prop_cold_fact + hab_type, nrow = 2, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
}

# ── Build all panels (4 lags × 2 metrics) and assemble ───────────────────────
panels_v2 <- purrr::map(sr_v2, \(x) {
  list(
    n = adult_sr_panel_v2(
      dat = x$ts, summ = x$summ,
      x_raw  = n_stock,      y_raw  = n_recruited,
      x_summ = n_stock_mean, y_summ = n_recruited_mean,
      x_sd   = n_stock_sd,   y_sd   = n_recruited_sd,
      pred_df = x$pred_n,
      x_lab = glue::glue("Total adults (N), Oct 1 year Y\u2212{x$lag}"),
      y_lab = "Total adults (N), Oct 1(Y) + harvest(Y)",
      title = glue::glue("{x$lag}-yr lag (abundance)")
    ),
    b = adult_sr_panel_v2(
      dat = x$ts, summ = x$summ,
      x_raw  = biom_stock,      y_raw  = biom_recruited,
      x_summ = biom_stock_mean, y_summ = biom_recruited_mean,
      x_sd   = biom_stock_sd,   y_sd   = biom_recruited_sd,
      pred_df = x$pred_b,
      x_lab = glue::glue("Total adults (kg), Oct 1 year Y\u2212{x$lag}"),
      y_lab = "Total adults (kg), Oct 1(Y) + harvest(Y)",
      title = glue::glue("{x$lag}-yr lag (biomass)")
    )
  )
})

(panels_v2[[1]]$n + panels_v2[[1]]$b) /
(panels_v2[[2]]$n + panels_v2[[2]]$b) /
(panels_v2[[3]]$n + panels_v2[[3]]$b) /
(panels_v2[[4]]$n + panels_v2[[4]]$b) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```


#### Compare representative SR relationships

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

lag2curves_v2 <- bind_rows(
  sr_v2[[3]]$pred_b |> mutate(measure = "biomass"),
  sr_v2[[3]]$pred_n |> mutate(measure = "abundance")
) |>
  mutate(surplus = y - x) |>
  filter(surplus > 0)

make_sr_plot_v2 <- function(m) {
  lag2curves_v2 |> filter(measure == m) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = hab_type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Habitat type") +
    facet_wrap(~prop_cold_fact, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Recruits") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

make_sp_plot_v2 <- function(m) {
  lag2curves_v2 |> filter(measure == m) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = surplus, color = hab_type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Habitat type") +
    facet_wrap(~prop_cold_fact, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = "Total adults (Oct 1 census)", y = "Surplus production") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

(make_sr_plot_v2("abundance") / make_sp_plot_v2("abundance")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Abundance \u2014 4-year lag SR and surplus production")

(make_sr_plot_v2("biomass") / make_sp_plot_v2("biomass")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Biomass \u2014 4-year lag SR and surplus production")
```


Ricker parameters (alpha, beta) and maximum surplus production from the 4-year lag fits, as a function of proportion cold habitat:
```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

ricker_params_ta <- purrr::map_dfr(sr_v2[[3]]$hab_fits, \(hf) {
  tibble(
    hab_type       = hf$hab_type,
    prop_cold_fact = hf$prop_cold_fact,
    prop_cold      = as.numeric(sub("% cold", "", hf$prop_cold_fact)) / 100,
    alpha_n        = hf$alpha_n,
    beta_n         = hf$beta_n,
    max_surplus_n  = max(hf$pred_n$y - hf$pred_n$x),
    alpha_b        = hf$alpha_b,
    beta_b         = hf$beta_b,
    max_surplus_b  = max(hf$pred_b$y - hf$pred_b$x)
  )
}) |>
  mutate(hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")))

p_alpha_ta <- ggplot(ricker_params_ta,
                     aes(x = prop_cold, color = hab_type, group = hab_type)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = alpha_n), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(aes(y = alpha_n, shape = "Abundance"), size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = alpha_b), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = alpha_b, shape = "Biomass"), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Habitat type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Abundance" = 16, "Biomass" = 17), name = "Measure") +
  pc_x +
  labs(y = "\u03b1 (ln scale)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p_beta_ta <- ggplot(ricker_params_ta,
                    aes(x = prop_cold, color = hab_type, group = hab_type)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = beta_n), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(aes(y = beta_n, shape = "Abundance"), size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = beta_b), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = beta_b, shape = "Biomass"), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Habitat type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Abundance" = 16, "Biomass" = 17), name = "Measure") +
  pc_x +
  labs(y = "\u03b2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p_maxsurp_ta <- ggplot(ricker_params_ta,
                       aes(x = prop_cold, color = hab_type, group = hab_type)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = max_surplus_n), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(aes(y = max_surplus_n, shape = "Abundance"), size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = max_surplus_b), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = max_surplus_b, shape = "Biomass"), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Habitat type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Abundance" = 16, "Biomass" = 17), name = "Measure") +
  pc_x +
  labs(y = "Max surplus") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

(p_alpha_ta + p_beta_ta + p_maxsurp_ta) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```


#### Surplus production vs. harvest rate

Surplus production per year is the signed distance above the 1:1 line: total recruited adults (Oct 1 census + same-year harvest) minus the total adult stock in year Y−lag. Positive = net gain; zero = replacement; negative = decline.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

sp_ts_ta <- purrr::map_dfr(sr_v2, \(x) {
  x$ts |>
    mutate(sp_n = n_recruited - n_stock,
           sp_b = biom_recruited - biom_stock,
           lag  = factor(x$lag, levels = 2:5,
                         labels = c("2-yr lag", "3-yr lag", "4-yr lag", "5-yr lag")),
           prod = log(n_recruited / n_stock))
})

sp_summ_ta <- sp_ts_ta |>
  group_by(lag, hab_type, prop_cold, prop_cold_fact, harvest_rate, harvest_rate_fact) |>
  summarise(
    n_stock_mean    = mean(n_stock),    n_stock_sd    = sd(n_stock),
    biom_stock_mean = mean(biom_stock), biom_stock_sd = sd(biom_stock),
    sp_n_mean = mean(sp_n), sp_n_sd = sd(sp_n),
    sp_b_mean = mean(sp_b), sp_b_sd = sd(sp_b),
    prod_mean = mean(prod), prod_sd  = sd(prod),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sp_base_ta <- ggplot(sp_summ_ta, aes(x = harvest_rate, color = lag, fill = lag)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = lag_pal, name = "Lag") +
  scale_fill_manual( values = lag_pal, name = "Lag") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = hr_levels_mech,
                     labels = hr_labels_mech,
                     name   = "Harvest rate") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  facet_grid(prop_cold_fact ~ hab_type) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

p_sp_n_ta <- sp_base_ta +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sp_n_mean - sp_n_sd,
                  ymax = sp_n_mean + sp_n_sd),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y  = sp_n_mean), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = sp_n_mean), size = 2, shape = 16) +
  labs(y = "Surplus production (N adults)",
       title = "Abundance surplus production")

p_sp_b_ta <- sp_base_ta +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sp_b_mean - sp_b_sd,
                  ymax = sp_b_mean + sp_b_sd),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y  = sp_b_mean), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = sp_b_mean), size = 2, shape = 16) +
  labs(y = "Surplus production (kg)",
       title = "Biomass surplus production")

p_sp_n_ta + p_sp_b_ta +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

Inspect relationships between productivity (logged recruits per total adult stock) and harvest rate and stock biomass.
```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8

p1_ta <- sp_ts_ta |> filter(lag == "4-yr lag") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = jitter(harvest_rate), y = prod, color = harvest_rate_fact)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 1.5, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = sp_summ_ta |> filter(lag == "2-yr lag"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3,
             aes(x = harvest_rate, y = prod_mean, color = harvest_rate_fact)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = sp_summ_ta |> filter(lag == "2-yr lag"),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                aes(x = harvest_rate,
                    ymin = prod_mean - prod_sd,
                    ymax = prod_mean + prod_sd,
                    color = harvest_rate_fact),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hr_pal, name = "Harvest rate") +
  facet_grid(prop_cold_fact ~ hab_type) +
  labs(x = "Harvest rate", y = "Productivity, ln(R/S)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

p2_ta <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = sp_ts_ta |> filter(lag == "2-yr lag"),
             aes(x = biom_stock, y = prod, color = harvest_rate_fact),
             alpha = 0.25, size = 1.5, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = sp_summ_ta |> filter(lag == "2-yr lag"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3,
             aes(x = biom_stock_mean, y = prod_mean, color = harvest_rate_fact)) +
  geom_errorbar(data = sp_summ_ta |> filter(lag == "2-yr lag"),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                aes(x    = biom_stock_mean,
                    ymin  = prod_mean - prod_sd,
                    ymax  = prod_mean + prod_sd,
                    color = harvest_rate_fact),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = sp_summ_ta |> filter(lag == "2-yr lag"),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x    = biom_stock_mean - biom_stock_sd,
                   xend = biom_stock_mean + biom_stock_sd,
                   y    = prod_mean, yend = prod_mean,
                   color = harvest_rate_fact)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hr_pal, name = "Harvest rate") +
  facet_grid(prop_cold_fact ~ hab_type) +
  labs(x = "Total adult stock biomass (kg)", y = "Productivity, ln(R/S)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

(p1_ta / p2_ta) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```


## Fry production vs. recruitment

Declining fry input with stable recruitment output demonstrates density-dependent compensation at the cold-habitat summer bottleneck. The gap between the two panels quantifies how much excess fry production the system can absorb before the bottleneck is breached.

```{r eval=FALSE}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6

get_annual_fry <- function(scen) {
  scen$fry_annual |>
    right_join(all_exp_years, by = "yr") |>
    replace_na(list(n_fry = 0L)) |>
    mutate(harvest_rate = factor(scen$hr,
                                 levels = hr_levels_mech,
                                 labels = hr_labels_mech),
           hab_type = scen$ht)
}

fry_ts    <- purrr::map_dfr(ibm_list_mech, get_annual_fry) |>
  filter(hab_type == "Cold only")
age0_cold <- age0_ts |>
  filter(hab_type == "Cold only")

p_fry <- ggplot(fry_ts, aes(x = yr, y = n_fry, color = harvest_rate)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 0.8, se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hr_pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Annual fry production",
                     labels = scales::label_comma(),
                     limits = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_rec <- ggplot(age0_cold, aes(x = yr, y = n_age0, color = harvest_rate)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 0.8, se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hr_pal, name = "Harvest rate") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Year") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Age-0 recruits (Nov. 1)",
                     labels = scales::label_comma(),
                     limits = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_fry / p_rec + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "right")
```
